forms.label: Dark rye, crusted
forms.sourceNote: Bread, rye. Public domain. Kvass is traditionally made from stale, well-crusted dark rye rather than a soft sandwich loaf, but no dedicated record exists for that distinction and the figures are close enough to state without an estimate marker. No density: the toasted crusts are steeped and then strained out, so they displace nothing in the finished drink.
